nodes.label: Security Boundaries
nodes.rationale: RLS, server-only secrets, server-side rate limits, schema validation, and server-side admin checks are non-negotiable.

nodes.label: Scope Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Avoid in-app chat, payments, AI moderation logic, dynamic categories, public full identity, and dedicated auth routes in v1.

nodes.label: Design Implementation Rules
nodes.rationale: Use locked Tailwind design tokens, mobile-first composition, and visible focus states.
